truth_pairs.note: 30 -> 60 days; shared provisional anchor so context retrieval should reach it.
No anchor on either side; only rare informative tokens can retrieve it.
Semantic paraphrase sharing no anchor and no informative token; retrieval loss expected.
One shared informative token retrieves it, but the expensive score is below the review floor.
shall not -> may not; short text forces review even at high similarity.
True counterpart is retrieved by context but capped out of the top-12 shortlist.
Score sits between the 0.72 default and the 0.74 variant, so the review-floor sweep changes its stage.
Score sits between the 0.84 and 0.86 automatic threshold, so the automatic sweep changes its disposition.
Margin is just above the 0.10 default and below the 0.12 variant, so the margin sweep changes its disposition.
Context retrieval returns only the unrelated anchored new element, which scores below the floor, so s07 retries via rare-token fallback and finds the true counterpart.
